text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Tachyon-chan said she's starting a 
new research project again... I wonder if 
she'll be okay...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what... I just can't help but 
worry. Facing mysterious liquids and 
objects for hours on end—"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
If you push yourself too hard, you'll ruin 
your health! Yeah, I'm definitely bringing 
you some snacks!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...That goes for you too, Trainer, okay? 
Even if you're busy, pushing yourself too 
hard is forbidden!"
